reason: Fifty bucks plus thirteen for shipping is way too much for a water bottle on my budget, and the cheaper bottle price only works if I sign up for a filter subscription, which is exactly the trap I try to avoid. My regular bottle and tap water are fine.
objection: They're basically pushing me into a recurring filter plan to get a fair price, and I've been burned before by 'cancel any time' subscriptions that weren't easy to cancel.
would_change_my_mind: If the bottle was around $25-30 with free shipping and no subscription, and I could just buy filters one-off when I need them.
